verdict.rationale: Appwrite's first-party docs say email/password login takes "just a few lines of code" with Argon2 hashing (appwrite-docs-29). They also document OAuth sign-in with GitHub, Google, Facebook and 30+ other providers, enabled from the Console Social providers tab (appwrite-docs-1, appwrite-docs-26, appwrite-docs-45). Together these cover both halves of the story and the "in minutes" claim. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the setup speed, and no SDK code samples in the evidence.
